findings.quote: provide three months’ pay for the army, and add ten thousand measures of grain.
findings.problem: Greek: πεντήκοντα τάλαντα ... αὐτῷ δοῦσι παραχρῆμα τριμήνου μισθοδοτῆσαι τὴν δύναμιν καὶ σίτου προσθεῖναι μυριάδας. The fifty talents are the means of paying the army three months (δοῦσι ... μισθοδοτῆσαι), not a separate item; and μυριάδας stands with no numeral (a number has dropped out or been lost), so 'ten thousand' is supplied, not read.
findings.proposed_fix: pay the army three months’ wages with it, and add myriads [numeral missing in the Greek] of grain.

units.note: The missing numeral before μυριάδας is a textual gap; the English should not state a figure. The preceding 'give him fifty talents' is accurate.
Chapter ends mid-word in the Greek (τὰς παρακει- / -μένας πόλεις in ch. 6); a pagination split, not a lacuna.

findings.quote: At this time Aristophanes the general arrived
findings.problem: Greek: Ἀριστόφαντος ὁ στρατηγός, i.e. Aristophantus (the Acarnanian strategos), not Aristophanes.
findings.proposed_fix: At this time Aristophantus the general arrived

units.note: The chapter title also reads 'Aristophanes the Acarnanian'; the name there should match.
